items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Well, who was Sam Nixon? Sam Nixon was his brother. Wow. He's a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player, too. Sam Nixon, yeah.

ctx.x: Well there's so many of them. Did you ever hear of Payton that had a band? Payton? Yeah, Billy Payton, Henry Payton? Yeah. He had Hughie Rankin on bass, I suppose. Yeah. And he had Charlie McCurdy at one time, I heard. Yeah. He's from uptown. I guess, I don't know. He played the accordion. Yeah. Did you know Jim Gibson? Gibson, Jim Gibson. He was a guitar player. Yeah, he was a guitar player. That's an old guitar player. Yeah.

Now, uh, they had, you heard of Philip Nixon, huh? Mm-hmm. He was a famous guitar player. Philip Nixon. Well, who was Sam Nixon? Sam Nixon was his brother. Wow. He's a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player, too. Sam Nixon, yeah.

Well, would those guys go around and serenade ever? No. They played in standing band. Oh. Yes, indeed. No. Well, there were some others in that family that played, huh? I don't remember. Willie? Could there have been a Willie or a Philip?
